selection_note: Six named public-source candidates from October 22 exploratory search; not blinded, no historical discovery claim.

candidates.original_contribution: Analysis of confidence and diversity in multi-agent debate.
candidates.evidence: Research abstract inspected; independent reproduction not performed.
candidates.ghostmesh_gap: Unknown marginal value of additional reviewers with correlated inputs.
candidates.connection_thesis: Connect epistemic independence studies to GhostMesh multi-agent review cost and accuracy.
candidates.proposed_experiment: Compare one evaluator, repeated same-model samples, shared-source models and independent-source models on fixed contested claims.
candidates.strongest_objection: Task selection and evaluator strength may dominate diversity effects.

candidates.original_contribution: Failure-step diagnosis from agent execution trajectories.
candidates.evidence: Primary research summary; no framework execution.
candidates.ghostmesh_gap: Failure explanation is not equivalent to verified recovery.
candidates.connection_thesis: Compare failure attribution to independently checked completion and recovery evidence.
candidates.proposed_experiment: Run fixed synthetic failed workflows through diagnostic approaches and score attribution against known injected causes.
candidates.strongest_objection: Research benchmark trajectories may not represent GhostMesh service failures.

candidates.original_contribution: Benchmark for agent-monitoring failure detection across trajectory classes.
candidates.evidence: Repository documentation only; benchmark not reproduced.
candidates.ghostmesh_gap: No fixed independent benchmark established for internal agent failure detection.
candidates.connection_thesis: Use a third-party test set to detect missing monitoring coverage.
candidates.proposed_experiment: Map a bounded ATFD subset to the same monitoring outputs and score detection with unknowns preserved.
candidates.strongest_objection: Benchmark taxonomy may not cover authority or outcome-verification failures.

candidates.original_contribution: Policy-as-code and human review for AI agent actions.
candidates.evidence: Repository description inspected, enforcement not executed.
candidates.ghostmesh_gap: Need concise comparison of tool-call authorization semantics.
candidates.connection_thesis: Compare policy controls conceptually without introducing a new runtime.
candidates.proposed_experiment: Map five allow/deny synthetic actions to both rule sets and identify unsupported guarantees.
candidates.strongest_objection: Integration would duplicate existing authority controls.

candidates.original_contribution: Combined runtime evidence, app context and agent intent representations.
candidates.evidence: Repository description; no independent sensor attestation.
candidates.ghostmesh_gap: Reconcile agent-reported effects with actual host evidence.
candidates.connection_thesis: Compare derived evidence graphs against existing deterministic host observations.
candidates.proposed_experiment: Use synthetic claimed tool actions and observed process/file events to measure supported versus inferred outcomes.
candidates.strongest_objection: Added instrumentation may increase complexity without improving independent verification.

candidates.original_contribution: Inspectable provenance path across local agent memory layers.
candidates.evidence: Repository documentation; no recovery test performed.
candidates.ghostmesh_gap: Possibility of simpler continuity record structures.
candidates.connection_thesis: Compare minimal durable memory against existing continuation requirements.
candidates.proposed_experiment: Perform the same interrupted-task reconstruction with equal-sized source fixtures.
candidates.strongest_objection: Memory retrieval cannot enforce authorization or independently establish outcome.
